# Error catalog API

Every raised `VoiceyError` uses one of these stable codes.

| Code | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [`VY-CFG-001`](../errors.md#vy-cfg-001) | The agent configuration is incomplete or incompatible. | Apply every listed configuration fix, then rerun validation. |
| [`VY-CFG-002`](../errors.md#vy-cfg-002) | The voicey.jsonc manifest could not be read or validated. | Correct the reported manifest field or resume voicey init. |
| [`VY-CFG-003`](../errors.md#vy-cfg-003) | The voicey.jsonc manifest could not be saved atomically. | Check project-directory permissions and available disk space, then retry. |
| [`VY-OBS-001`](../errors.md#vy-obs-001) | The protected call-record database could not be opened or closed. | Check the data-directory permissions and disk health, then retry. |
| [`VY-OBS-002`](../errors.md#vy-obs-002) | A call-record observation could not be committed durably. | Resolve the reported repository error before accepting more calls. |
| [`VY-OBS-003`](../errors.md#vy-obs-003) | The requested call record does not exist. | Run `voicey calls list` and retry with an existing call id. |
| [`VY-OBS-004`](../errors.md#vy-obs-004) | The call-record schema is newer or incompatible. | Install the matching voicey version or run its documented upgrade. |
| [`VY-OBS-005`](../errors.md#vy-obs-005) | The requested call-record query is outside safe limits. | Choose a result limit from 1 through 1000. |
| [`VY-OBS-006`](../errors.md#vy-obs-006) | Prometheus or OTLP observability could not be configured or served. | Correct the observability endpoint, header env, bind address, or port and retry. |
| [`VY-SEC-001`](../errors.md#vy-sec-001) | A protected local path has unsafe permissions. | Restore owner-only permissions and rerun the command. |
| [`VY-SEC-002`](../errors.md#vy-sec-002) | A protected local file path is a symbolic link. | Replace the link with a regular file inside the protected data directory. |
| [`VY-RES-001`](../errors.md#vy-res-001) | A webhook secret is not a valid whsec_ value. | Generate or paste a whsec_-prefixed base64 webhook secret. |
| [`VY-RES-002`](../errors.md#vy-res-002) | Required Standard Webhooks headers are missing or malformed. | Forward webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, and webhook-signature unchanged. |
| [`VY-RES-003`](../errors.md#vy-res-003) | The webhook timestamp is outside the replay-tolerance window. | Correct receiver clock skew and reject the replayed request. |
| [`VY-RES-004`](../errors.md#vy-res-004) | The Standard Webhooks signature does not match the raw request body. | Verify the raw body with the current or previous whsec_ secret. |
| [`VY-RES-005`](../errors.md#vy-res-005) | results.set() was called outside an active call context. | Call results.set() only from flow or tool code running for an active call. |
| [`VY-RES-006`](../errors.md#vy-res-006) | The call owner no longer holds the current fencing generation. | Stop the stale worker; only the current lease owner may mutate the call. |
| [`VY-RES-007`](../errors.md#vy-res-007) | The call is terminal but its immutable terminal event is missing. | Stop accepting calls and restore the repository from a consistent backup. |
| [`VY-RES-008`](../errors.md#vy-res-008) | A lifecycle, outbox, or retention transaction failed. | Resolve the reported storage condition before accepting more calls. |
| [`VY-RES-009`](../errors.md#vy-res-009) | The requested immutable result event does not exist. | Run `voicey calls list` and retry with an existing call or event id. |
| [`VY-RES-010`](../errors.md#vy-res-010) | A recording update is missing, premature, or not engine-owned. | Retry after terminal persistence with the stable engine recording id. |
| [`VY-REL-001`](../errors.md#vy-rel-001) | The results-relay URL, credential, or protocol setting is invalid. | Correct the relay configuration and rotate any exposed credential. |
| [`VY-REL-002`](../errors.md#vy-rel-002) | The results relay is unavailable or failed its startup readiness check. | Restore the relay before allowing the cloud worker to accept calls. |
| [`VY-REL-003`](../errors.md#vy-rel-003) | A results-relay request is unsigned, expired, replayed, or invalid. | Synchronize clocks and use a current relay credential to sign a fresh request. |
| [`VY-REL-004`](../errors.md#vy-rel-004) | A results-relay fencing token is invalid, expired, or stale. | Stop the stale worker and resume with the server-issued current generation. |
| [`VY-REL-005`](../errors.md#vy-rel-005) | A results-relay operation is out of order or reuses an idempotency key. | Retry the same operation bytes or resume at the server-reported sequence. |
| [`VY-REL-006`](../errors.md#vy-rel-006) | The durable results-relay journal or backing repository failed. | Stop worker admission, restore durable relay storage, and retry recovery. |
| [`VY-ART-001`](../errors.md#vy-art-001) | An artifact key escapes protected storage or targets a symbolic link. | Use a relative recordings/ or backups/ key with no parent traversal. |
| [`VY-ART-002`](../errors.md#vy-art-002) | A protected artifact could not be written, read, or deleted. | Check artifact-store permissions and disk health, then retry. |
| [`VY-ART-003`](../errors.md#vy-art-003) | Durable object storage is misconfigured, unreachable, or failed preflight. | Correct the private bucket, HTTPS endpoint, credentials, and region, then rerun deploy. |
| [`VY-TOL-001`](../errors.md#vy-tol-001) | A callable is not registered as a voicey tool. | Decorate the typed function with @tool before registering it. |
| [`VY-TOL-002`](../errors.md#vy-tol-002) | A Python tool declaration cannot produce a safe JSON schema. | Use a valid name, typed non-variadic parameters, and a return annotation. |
| [`VY-TOL-003`](../errors.md#vy-tol-003) | The tool executor configuration is invalid. | Use a positive execution timeout and retry the command. |
| [`VY-TOL-004`](../errors.md#vy-tol-004) | An HTTP tool is misconfigured or its remote request failed. | Check the method, URL parameters, environment credentials, and endpoint. |
| [`VY-TOL-005`](../errors.md#vy-tol-005) | A final tool observation could not be persisted. | Stop accepting calls and restore protected observation storage before retrying. |
| [`VY-TEL-001`](../errors.md#vy-tel-001) | The requested telephony adapter or its optional dependency is unavailable. | Install the exact carrier extra, for example `uv pip install "voicey[twilio]"`. |
| [`VY-TEL-002`](../errors.md#vy-tel-002) | A telephony target, credential, number, or adapter setting is invalid. | Correct the reported carrier setting and run `voicey doctor` before retrying. |
| [`VY-TEL-003`](../errors.md#vy-tel-003) | A carrier phone number lookup returned no unique result. | List owned numbers, select one exact E.164 number, and retry. |
| [`VY-TEL-004`](../errors.md#vy-tel-004) | The carrier definitively rejected an operation. | Resolve the safe carrier status/code reported by doctor, then retry explicitly. |
| [`VY-TEL-005`](../errors.md#vy-tel-005) | A durable telephony routing snapshot or outbound intent could not be stored. | Stop carrier mutations and restore the protected telephony ledger. |
| [`VY-TEL-006`](../errors.md#vy-tel-006) | Carrier routing changed after voicey applied its temporary target. | Review the current carrier route; restore manually or retry with an explicit snapshot. |
| [`VY-TEL-007`](../errors.md#vy-tel-007) | An outbound carrier operation has an ambiguous outcome and was not retried. | Reconcile the reported intent id before deciding whether to place another call. |
| [`VY-TEL-008`](../errors.md#vy-tel-008) | A signed carrier callback has an unknown or incomplete event shape. | Inspect safe callback metadata and update the carrier mapping before accepting calls. |
| [`VY-TEL-009`](../errors.md#vy-tel-009) | An authenticated carrier recording could not be downloaded safely. | Check the recording SID, account credentials, size limit, and carrier availability. |
| [`VY-TEL-010`](../errors.md#vy-tel-010) | A carrier media frame violates the certified codec or stream protocol. | Reject the frame and inspect the carrier media-stream configuration. |
| [`VY-TEL-011`](../errors.md#vy-tel-011) | The carrier API is unavailable or returned an indeterminate infrastructure error. | Check carrier status and connectivity; reconcile mutations before any explicit retry. |
| [`VY-TEL-012`](../errors.md#vy-tel-012) | A warm-transfer handoff did not reach one safe, confirmed conference state. | Keep the caller with the agent, inspect the reported transfer id, and retry only after its provider state is terminal. |
| [`VY-RUN-001`](../errors.md#vy-run-001) | The selected runtime or one of its pinned optional dependencies is unavailable. | Install the runtime extra printed by the command and rerun `voicey doctor`. |
| [`VY-RUN-002`](../errors.md#vy-run-002) | A runtime provider model, credential, or voice setting cannot be constructed. | Correct the reported provider setting or key, then rerun `voicey doctor`. |
| [`VY-RUN-003`](../errors.md#vy-run-003) | The native runtime flow entrypoint is missing, invalid, or failed to initialize. | Export the documented native flow entrypoint and run its runtime tests. |
| [`VY-RUN-004`](../errors.md#vy-run-004) | The runtime cannot admit another call at the configured concurrency limit. | Wait for an active call to finish or raise limits.max_concurrent with enough capacity. |
| [`VY-RUN-005`](../errors.md#vy-run-005) | A media connection is not bound to a valid answer-time call reservation. | Reject the connection and verify the signed carrier or web-session handshake. |
| [`VY-RUN-006`](../errors.md#vy-run-006) | The runtime call lifecycle could not be started, renewed, or finalized safely. | Stop admitting calls, restore durable storage, then run the recovery command. |
| [`VY-RUN-007`](../errors.md#vy-run-007) | The runtime host received a malformed or unauthenticated signaling request. | Verify the expected public URL, proxy trust, signature, and signaling payload. |
| [`VY-RUN-008`](../errors.md#vy-run-008) | The runtime is draining and cannot expose a new call. | Route the new call to the ready generation and let this generation finish existing calls. |
| [`VY-TUN-001`](../errors.md#vy-tun-001) | The selected tunnel provider dependency or executable is unavailable. | Install the exact tunnel extra or executable named by the error, then retry. |
| [`VY-TUN-002`](../errors.md#vy-tun-002) | The tunnel provider, local port, public URL, or protocol is invalid. | Use a supported provider, a free TCP port, and an HTTPS public origin. |
| [`VY-TUN-003`](../errors.md#vy-tun-003) | The tunnel process exited or did not publish a valid public URL in time. | Check provider connectivity and safe tunnel diagnostics, then retry. |
| [`VY-TUN-004`](../errors.md#vy-tun-004) | The public tunnel failed its authenticated WebSocket round-trip probe. | Do not point a carrier; repair WebSocket upgrade forwarding and rerun doctor. |
| [`VY-TUN-005`](../errors.md#vy-tun-005) | The tunnel process or listener could not be shut down cleanly. | Stop the reported tunnel process before starting another development session. |
| [`VY-WEB-001`](../errors.md#vy-web-001) | A browser session token is missing, expired, replayed, or has the wrong scope. | Return to the local playground and start a new browser session. |
| [`VY-WEB-002`](../errors.md#vy-web-002) | A browser origin, public host, or forwarded-header chain is not trusted. | Use an allowed origin and configure every trusted proxy plus the exact public URL. |
| [`VY-WEB-003`](../errors.md#vy-web-003) | Browser-session issuance or signaling exceeded its abuse limit. | Wait for the printed retry interval or end an active session before retrying. |
| [`VY-WEB-004`](../errors.md#vy-web-004) | An admin or session-issuance request lacks the configured integrator credential. | Use the local admin listener or supply the configured integrator authorization. |
| [`VY-WEB-005`](../errors.md#vy-web-005) | The embedded playground assets or development reload could not be prepared safely. | Rebuild the wheel assets or fix the reported project module before retrying. |
| [`VY-DEP-001`](../errors.md#vy-dep-001) | A deployment artifact conflicts with an existing project file. | Review or move the reported file; voicey never overwrites deployment edits. |
| [`VY-DEP-002`](../errors.md#vy-dep-002) | The deployment persistence topology is unsafe or incompatible. | Use the target's documented storage backend, local volume, and replica topology, then rerun the persistence preflight. |
| [`VY-DEP-003`](../errors.md#vy-dep-003) | The production container runtime configuration is incomplete or invalid. | Set every documented deployment environment variable, then rerun `voicey doctor`. |
| [`VY-DEP-004`](../errors.md#vy-dep-004) | Post-deploy smoke verification failed or lacks a required live-call input. | Correct the printed URL/number/credential requirement and rerun the smoke command. |
| [`VY-DEP-005`](../errors.md#vy-dep-005) | Docker or Compose could not validate the generated deployment. | Install a supported Docker Compose release, fix the reported validation, and retry. |
| [`VY-DEP-006`](../errors.md#vy-dep-006) | A managed deployment CLI is missing, unauthenticated, timed out, or failed. | Install and authenticate the printed platform CLI, then rerun the same command. |
| [`VY-DEP-007`](../errors.md#vy-dep-007) | Managed deployment resource identity, ownership, placement, or checkpoint evidence drifted. | Inspect the platform resources and owner-only resource ledger; explicitly adopt only verified resources, restore the recorded identity, or co-locate managed storage with its service before retrying. |
| [`VY-DEP-008`](../errors.md#vy-dep-008) | A cloud-worker build, runtime bootstrap, or explicit deployment plan is invalid. | Correct the named runtime, image, region, relay, wheel, project, or secret input and regenerate the cloud artifacts. |
| [`VY-DEP-009`](../errors.md#vy-dep-009) | A required Pipecat Cloud or LiveKit Cloud CLI is missing, unauthenticated, timed out, or failed. | Install and authenticate the pinned platform CLI, inspect its direct output, then rerun the same resumable voicey command. |
| [`VY-DEP-010`](../errors.md#vy-dep-010) | Cloud agent ownership, secret-sync, deployment, or rollback evidence is unsafe. | Inspect the owner-only cloud ledger and platform agent; adopt the exact id explicitly, restore the ledgered version, or pass --migrate-relay only after the replacement companion passes signed readiness. |
| [`VY-TST-001`](../errors.md#vy-tst-001) | A simulated-caller scenario, profile, filter, or test config is invalid. | Correct the reported tests/scenarios source or tests/voicey-test.jsonc field. |
| [`VY-TST-002`](../errors.md#vy-tst-002) | A native runtime evaluator is unavailable or rejected generated test inputs. | Install the selected runtime extra and use the pinned version shown by doctor. |
| [`VY-TST-003`](../errors.md#vy-tst-003) | A configured test tier, sim-caller model, or judge could not execute. | Start the configured local model or supply the documented cloud/live prerequisites. |
| [`VY-TST-004`](../errors.md#vy-tst-004) | One or more voice-agent scenarios failed a hard or judged assertion. | Review the transcript, cited judge reason, and stability attempts before retrying. |
| [`VY-TST-005`](../errors.md#vy-tst-005) | A soak run is invalid or exceeded a call, file-descriptor, or memory bound. | Inspect the soak report, fix the leaked resource or terminal call, then rerun the same duration and concurrency. |
| [`VY-CLI-001`](../errors.md#vy-cli-001) | A non-interactive command is missing an explicit required choice. | Pass the exact flag named by the error or rerun in an interactive terminal. |
| [`VY-CLI-002`](../errors.md#vy-cli-002) | The guided setup was cancelled, conflicted, or cannot be resumed safely. | Rerun `voicey init --resume` or choose a new empty project directory. |
| [`VY-CLI-003`](../errors.md#vy-cli-003) | A project scaffold or protected environment file could not be written safely. | Check project permissions and disk space, then resume `voicey init`. |
| [`VY-CLI-004`](../errors.md#vy-cli-004) | A required provider key is missing, invalid, or could not be verified. | Run the printed `voicey keys add <provider>` command and validate again. |
| [`VY-CLI-005`](../errors.md#vy-cli-005) | The requested runtime, carrier, recipe, deploy target, or extra is unavailable. | Choose an enabled capability or install the exact extra printed by the command. |
| [`VY-CLI-006`](../errors.md#vy-cli-006) | One or more doctor preflight checks failed. | Apply each printed advice line, then rerun `voicey doctor`. |
| [`VY-CLI-007`](../errors.md#vy-cli-007) | The command cannot run from the current project or lifecycle state. | Run the printed next step or resume the interrupted command first. |
| [`VY-CLI-008`](../errors.md#vy-cli-008) | A consequential package, money-spending, or live-routing mutation lacks confirmation. | Review the exact mutation, then confirm interactively or pass `--yes`. |
| [`VY-CLI-009`](../errors.md#vy-cli-009) | A CLI operation failed without a safe provider-specific mapping. | Retry with `--verbose`; if it repeats, use the printed pre-filled issue link. |
| [`VY-CLI-010`](../errors.md#vy-cli-010) | A command output request or filter is malformed. | Correct the reported flag, identifier, or JSON/output option and retry. |
| [`VY-UPG-001`](../errors.md#vy-upg-001) | The project or installed uv version cannot support a safe voicey upgrade. | Use a regular uv-managed project with a direct voicey dependency and uv >=0.11,<1. |
| [`VY-UPG-002`](../errors.md#vy-upg-002) | The lockfile-only voicey upgrade or fresh-process verification failed. | Review the safe error detail; the prior lockfile was restored when available. |
| [`VY-UPG-003`](../errors.md#vy-upg-003) | Recipe baseline metadata or source drift is invalid or unsafe to compare. | Restore the tracked recipe baseline and regular recipe-owned files, then retry. |

See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md) for symptom-oriented routing.
